sources.title: Create Educational AI Models with the Teachable Machine Tool
sources.snippet: How to Create Educational AI Models with the Teachable Machine Tool? Learn about Teachable Machine, an AI tool that you can adapt for various educational applications in the classroom. Students can design, train, and evaluate an artificial intelligence model that can be applied to solve a problem. In this article, you'll find practical examples.
